html:
Home Services Company Atlanta

Build Heritage is the home‑services contractor you need in metro Atlanta and the surrounding Georgia cities. We handle eight trades—Packing & Moving, Painting, Drywall, Flooring & Vinyl, Framing, Doors, Window & Door Trim, and Roofing & Tiles—so you can get a single, itemized quote for any project.

How to Get a Quote

  1. Fill out the online form or email info@buildheritage.org.
  2. Receive a written, itemized estimate within one business day.
  3. Review the estimate, approve it, and schedule the work.
  4. Our crew completes the job, and we walk through the finished work with you.

What to Expect

  • Free, written, itemized quotes delivered in one business day.
  • Cost ranges from the 2026 cost guide: full roof replacement $9,000–$20,000; whole‑home interior repaint $3,000–$8,000.
  • Hold back 10–15 % of the quoted amount for hidden issues.
  • Licensed and insured in Georgia.
  • Service areas include Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Johns Creek, Duluth, Lawrenceville, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Cumming, Gainesville, Athens, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, and Columbus.

FAQ

How quickly will I get a quote? You’ll receive a written, itemized quote within one business day after you submit the form or email.

Do you work in other Atlanta‑area cities? Yes. Build Heritage serves Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Johns Creek, Duluth, Lawrenceville, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Cumming, Gainesville, Athens, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, and Columbus.

What trades are included? We provide Packing & Moving, Painting, Drywall, Flooring & Vinyl, Framing, Doors, Window & Door Trim, and Roofing & Tiles.

Next Step

Ready to start your project? Get your free quote now.
